reviews.title: No Sync between watch and phone. iPhone and apple watch
reviews.text: After all my efforts watch and phone shows two different sets of translations. Phone is up-to-date with the new revised English translation whereas watch keeps showing the old version. Even after resetting and reinstalling, the watch goes back to the old and phone keeps the new version. Why.

reviews.title: Needs Updating. Very poor
reviews.text: The webpage is much easier to use. My main interest is quick access to the daily readings. The instructions to bring up the toolbar on my IPhone simply don’t work.

reviews.title: Not user friendly
reviews.text: I've still not got what I'm looking for  I couldn't set the pages for Sunday 12th English Westminster Mass readings and I'm still not able to retrieve this Sunday 18th English Westminster Mass reading . It's so complicated and I've not had communication from the contact help email I sent

reviews.title: Access
reviews.text:
Since subscribing to the app I cannot open the daily readings- there is no option on the toolbars to do this. I purchased the app for ease of use whilst on holiday. But it will only open on compline of each day with a block background- not like the general site - mores the point I cannot access any of the prayers only night prayers
Please can you help 🙏🏻💕
